title: HfsPlusLegacy
tip: Uses HfsPlusLegacy; typically for 3rd Gen and older legacy platforms, especially Pentium and Celeron processors. If OpenCore UI does not show (stuck at logo, grey screen), try HfsPlus or OpenHfsPlus.

title: HfsPlus
tip: Uses HfsPlus; typically for 3rd Gen and newer platforms. If OpenCore UI does not show (stuck at logo, grey screen), try HfsPlusLegacy or OpenHfsPlus.

title: OpenHfsPlus
tip: Uses OpenHfsPlus; typically for 3rd Gen and newer platforms (Pentium/Celeron). If OpenCore UI does not show, try HfsPlusLegacy or HfsPlus.
